Mike?

Mike, stop.

Look at me.

It’s Rich.

You told me not to open the door. I listened. I did exactly what you said.

But I need you, man.

I cannot be the only one left in this house.

Not after Dad.

Please, give me something.

Say my name.

Tell me I’m wrong.

Do not make me fight you.

Please.

This cannot be how you come home.
